# Listen

For each voice you hear the engine's render of a patch (the recording), the patches two fits recovered from that recording alone, one started from the default patch and one from the regressor's prediction, and that prediction itself before any search; the audio is rendered when the site is built, from the committed voices and the recovered parameters below.

Each fit ran with `patchback fit`'s defaults (seed 0, at most 2,000 renders and 4 restarts) but a wall-time bound of 600 s, which none reached. The regressor is a demo model trained with ModelSpec 0.5.0 on a generated dataset; its prediction is clamped to the parameter ranges, and the label says how many of its outputs were. A loss of 0 is identical audio. [Fit a recording](guides/fit-a-recording.md) shows the same fit on your own file.
